title: The WalkUp: a bar that's easy to find, one flight up
tag: Cocktail bar, Cary, NC · Launching Nov 2026
summaryLead: A site for the cocktail bar above happy's in downtown Cary. It's written like a printed menu, with a seasonal drink list, glasses that pour, and real photos of the room.
story: The WalkUp sits one flight above happy's, and people walk past the door without knowing it's there. The page opens on the room itself with the lights coming up on exposed brick, and says it in the headline: a little above the usual. The type is a Georgia italic with Lekton, a typewriter-style mono, for the details, set in cream, forest green and gold. Numbered labels and a small staircase rule between sections give it the feel of a printed menu, and the steps point you up the page.
goals: Tell first-timers the bar is upstairs.
Let people read the seasonal menu before they come.
Show the room, the hours and the price, and take a message without a booking system.

features.title: A little above the usual
features.text: The hero is the room, with the lights coming up on the brick.
features.alt: The WalkUp home page: exposed brick and timber beams behind the headline A little above the usual
features.story: The photo starts dark and fades up over a couple of seconds, like walking in. The address line sits at the bottom: 126 West Chatham Street, upstairs, above happy's. Two buttons go to the menu or the visit details.

features.title: The menu, in tabs
features.text: Cocktails, beer, wine, snacks, non-alcoholic and the printed menu, with prices and a running tab.
features.alt: The WalkUp menu with tabs for cocktails, beer, wine, snacks and non-alcoholic
features.story: The Fall / Winter 2026 list changes often, so it's one tab per section and easy to edit. Tapping an item adds it to a tab. It's only a tally for planning a round, since everyone orders at the counter.

features.title: Glasses that pour
features.text: Each specialty cocktail has a small glass that fills with its ingredients.
features.alt: The WalkUp specialty cocktails with small glasses beside each drink
features.story: Hover a glass, or tap it on a phone, and it fills layer by layer so you can see what's in the drink. There's a replay link under each one. The page says the drawings aren't recipes, because they aren't.

features.title: The room
features.text: Four photos, in an uneven layout, with a short caption on each.
features.alt: The WalkUp room: the long bar and the upper lounge
features.story: The brick, timber beams and plants are the reason to come, so the room gets real photos: the bar, the upper lounge, the menu at the bar and the lounge seating.

features.title: Reviews
features.text: Two large quotes from Google reviews, with the reviewer's name under each.
features.alt: The WalkUp reviews section, Good nights. Kind words.
features.story: Quotes are set big in the serif, with a thin gold rule above and below. A button opens more.

features.title: Visit
features.text: Plain-text hours, the address, phone, email, price and an email sign-up.
features.alt: The WalkUp visit section with hours, address and email sign-up
features.story: The section turns dark green, like the room at night. Hours are a simple table, with indoor and outdoor seating and a $10 to $20 price per person. Sign-up and the message form go through Netlify Forms, with a note that the page doesn't book tables or take orders.

features.text: The hero, menu tabs and room photos at 390px wide.
